source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Complete elimination of fluid intake, with fairly little regard for what the client's provider has actually recommended","B":"An individualized fluid limit as recommended by the provider, along with strategies to manage thirst and track fluid intake","C":"An identical fluid limit applied to most heart failure clients, with fairly little regard for their individual severity","D":"Fairly little specific fluid limit at all, based on the belief that restriction is unnecessary in heart failure"}}
source_row.rationale: Fluid restriction education for heart failure typically includes an individualized fluid limit as recommended by the provider (based on the client's specific condition and severity), along with practical strategies to manage thirst and accurately track fluid intake throughout the day.
source_row.source_name: AHA — Heart Failure Fluid Management Education
